# Pyodide 314.0.8

Pinned upstream browser artifacts from [Pyodide 314.0.8](https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/pyodide/v314.0.8/full/). This build bundles CPython 3.14.2 and SQLite. The course lazily loads this directory in its dedicated browser worker. It does not fetch or install additional packages.

Upstream source is available from [Pyodide](https://github.com/pyodide/pyodide/tree/314.0.8) and [CPython](https://github.com/python/cpython/tree/v3.14.2). Their notices are included in [LICENSE-Pyodide](LICENSE-Pyodide) and [LICENSE-Python](LICENSE-Python).
